summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, announcing that between October 12 and October 13, 2026, holders exercised 273,493,909 traditional warrants into 13,674,703 Class A shares, generating expected gross proceeds of $369.2 million. No traditional warrants from the PIPE transaction remain outstanding. Separately, Strive purchased 2,822 bitcoin at roughly $83,266 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The warrant overhang is cleared, simplifying capital structure. Watch bitcoin treasury mark-to-market and whether proceeds fund further accumulation or preferred dividends.
